With no qualifying in-radius fix anywhere in the 15 minutes before the 12:34:59 cancellation, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the cancellation fee is refundable in full.

Even taking the driver's 'I'm Here' tap at 12:30:36 at face value, POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the tap, and there is no such fix: the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period carried on this record (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a shortfall of 180 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable on that shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to messages.

The driver's 258.2 m minimum distance sits outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, so failing the geofence test does not let the fee through: this is a wrong-approach case and the fee is refunded in full on either branch. If the driver was stationary there for the required dwell, POL-NS-03 governs and refunds in full; if he was not, POL-NS-02's own rule refunds in full because no qualifying in-radius fix exists. Fault is allocated to the driver under POL-NS-03 limb (i): the rider named her location in the chat at 12:30:56 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A') and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:34:59.

Rider presence is affirmatively established for POL-NS-04 limb (c)'s rider-presence test: 54 rider fixes, all 54 qualifying, running 12:28:14 to 12:36:13, never more than 19.9 m from the pin and therefore far inside the 150 m rider presence radius for this LARGE_VENUE zone. I do not rely on POL-NS-04 as a whole for the refund, which comes from POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06, but the presence fact this limb tests is exactly the fact the trip record's RIDER_NO_SHOW code denies.

No driver compensation can attach. POL-NS-07 pays at 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and POL-NS-06 independently displaces it, and POL-NS-03 limb (i) puts the loss on the driver because he was told the entrance and did not move. The $4.50 cancellation line on EV-FARE-02712 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is therefore refundable in full with a nil driver payout.

The missing dwell cannot be topped up by summing separate in-geofence intervals: POL-NS-06 limb (i) permits that only where a traffic_advisory is present and populated and carries a type of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. EV-ADVIS-02712-01 is MISSING, has a null payload and carries weight 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable, the zero dwell stands, and no exculpation can be built on that absent artifact.

The 12:30:36 arrival is a driver-pressed marker, not a platform measurement: trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is 'BUTTON', and POL-NS-12 covers only GPS_AUTO arrivals. POL-NS-12 therefore cannot convert that tap into a platform-confirmed arrival, and the marker remains subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05, where a trace whose minimum distance is 258.2 m with zero in-radius fixes means the tap starts no waiting clock at all.

The record is clean enough to decide without escalation: EV-TRIP-02712, EV-GPS-02712, EV-CHAT-02712 and EV-FARE-02712 are all COMPLETE at weight 1.0, the trace has 100 percent coverage with no gaps and a 10 s cadence, the chat sequence and read receipts are intact, and the $4.50 cancellation line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) fire nowhere. The 180 second shortfall the derived arrival block reports is a measurement of in-geofence dwell - i.e. of the driver's position - not of the time he allowed the rider.

The fee is not chargeable on this evidence and the driver does not assert otherwise.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the $4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02712 (EV-FARE-02712, cancellation_fee $4.50, total_charged $4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd $0.00) is refunded in full to the rider. No driver compensation is paid.

Why the fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs. Limbs (a) and (d) are recorded: the trip record carries the driver's arrival event at 12:30:36 and a driver termination at 12:34:59 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW (one of the three codes limb (d) recognises). But limb (b) and limb (c) fail. This is a LARGE_VENUE pickup (EV-TRIP-02712, pickup_zone_class LARGE_VENUE), so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m, not 50 m, and the driver's own trace (EV-GPS-02712) never places him inside it: his closest approach to the pin is 258.2 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), the qualifying in-radius fix count is 0, and the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 s. Limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'I'm Here' tap, and against the 180 s free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02712, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) the shortfall is 180 s. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable on that shortfall alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to messages.

The driver advocate's 263-second argument (claim 3, and the shortfall being 'a measurement of position, not of time allowed') is answered on its own terms and rejected as a ground for keeping the fee: the 263 s runs from 12:30:36 to 12:34:59, it is the time the driver allowed, and limb (c) does not measure from the button press. The driver's closest approach (258.2 m) sits outside the 120 m radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, so POL-NS-03 independently refunds in full — he did not arrive at the pickup point. Both routes (POL-NS-02 for a trace with no in-radius fix at all, POL-NS-03 for a stationary position within 400 m) end in the same full refund, and the driver advocate properly concedes the fee is not chargeable.

Why there is no driver payment. POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; limb (b) fails and POL-NS-06 independently displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 puts the loss on the driver for compensation purposes: the rider stated a specific sub-location in the chat log at 12:30:56 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A', EV-CHAT-02712) and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:34:59. The pin-ambiguity goodwill of $2.25 (POL-NS-03(ii)) is unavailable because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more, and because the rider did specify a sub-location. The driver's anti-farming position (claim 5) is correct as far as it goes — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 92, so neither limb of the POL-NS-07 check trips, and those are the only profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for that test — but it changes nothing, because no compensation route is reached.

The rider's POL-NS-04 point is not needed and does not carry her case: the driver replied 'ok' at 12:31:26, within 120 seconds of the rider's 12:30:56 message, so the clause does not exonerate her on driver non-response. Her presence is in fact affirmatively established (54 qualifying rider fixes, never more than 19.9 m from the pin, well inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius), which contradicts the RIDER_NO_SHOW label, but the refund follows from the driver's own trace under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 regardless. Her point that the 12:30:36 event is a driver-pressed marker is accepted: arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12 does not convert that tap into a platform-confirmed arrival. I do not record a false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii): that referral requires the GPS to place the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the arrival timestamp or moving at 15 km/h or more, and a closest approach of 258.2 m establishes neither, so no clause-mandated referral fires here.

Confidence and effect. The facts the ruling rests on are carried by EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 and EV-CHAT-02712, all COMPLETE at weight 1.0, and the $4.50 fare line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so no POL-NS-08 limb (a)–(d) fires and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger holds; confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02712-01 (weight 0.0) carries no fact relied on here. The monetary effect ($4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically on issue, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. Two rider claims that relied on the weight-0.0 advisory without disclosing its MISSING_ARTIFACT impairment were discarded by the referee and are recorded in the audit below.

To both parties. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02712 (EV-FARE-02712: total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded in full to the rider. No driver compensation is payable.

The fee cannot stand under POL-NS-01. Limb (a) is met (the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:30:36) and limb (d) is met on its face (the driver terminated at 12:34:59 under RIDER_NO_SHOW), but limb (b) is decided by the GPS geofence, not by the tap: on EV-GPS-02712 the driver's closest approach to the pin is 258.2 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), well outside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup (trip_record.pickup_zone_class), and the trace contains 0 qualifying in-radius fixes (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count = 0, longest qualifying run 0.0 s). Limb (b) fails, and limb (c) fails with it: the in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period carried on the record (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a 180 s shortfall under POL-NS-06. POL-NS-02 confirms the full refund.

Because the closest fixes lie outside the 120 m radius but within POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling (258.2 m < 400 m), the trip is a wrong-approach case and POL-NS-03 also refunds the fee in full. Fault for driver compensation runs against the driver: the rider's locating message at 12:30:56 on EV-CHAT-02712 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A') named her entrance, and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:34:59 - POL-NS-03 limb (i); the pin-ambiguity goodwill in limb (ii) is unavailable because registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more. POL-NS-07 therefore pays nothing.

On the driver's points: I accept that POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are made out, that 263 s elapsed from the 12:30:36 tap to the 12:34:59 cancellation, and that POL-NS-07's anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the 4 required, and 1/92 = 1.09 percent, below the 8 percent limb) - those being the only profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for this test.
